about_the_game:
Primal Frost throws you into a high-stakes, fast-paced FPS adventure set in the frozen breeding grounds of deadly, feathered raptors. Armed with a trusty shotgun, you’ll need to think fast, act faster, and stay one step ahead of these cunning predators.

Your mission? Venture into the snowy landscape to collect raptor nests while dodging their relentless pursuit. Use the environment to your advantage—hide in tall grass to evade detection, and make every shot count. The icy terrain and limited visibility heighten the tension, keeping you on edge with every step.

The clock is ticking—once you’ve secured the nests, race to the extraction point where a helicopter waits to carry you to safety. But beware: the raptors won’t let you leave without a fight.

Primal Frost combines heart-pounding action with stealth and strategy in a beautifully harsh prehistoric world. With its fast-paced gameplay and atmospheric setting, this short yet intense single-player experience will keep you hooked from start to finish. Can you survive the cold and outsmart nature's fiercest hunters?

Perfect for fans of adrenaline-packed, dinosaur adventures!

short_description: A singleplayer hardcore prehistoric arctic experience. Collect all the nests and wait for extraction. 15 - 45 minutes of gameplay. NOTE: This game is challenging! Defend yourself from feathered raptors, hide in tall brush, and keep your shotgun loaded.
